profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer with five years of professional experience. My current position is Software Engineer, Integrations at Gundersen Health System (becoming Emplify Health). I am a full stack developer with experience in Java, Spring Boot, SQL/U-SQL/KQL, some C#, JavaScript/React/Vue.js, Forgerock, and Epic integrations. My favorite area is back end development- Java and SQL, though I like doing front end too and appreciate clean web design. Integrations is a fun niche as we get to maintain connections to many different systems.

Alumni of Northwestern University, University of Wisconsin-Madison, and Western Technical College. United States Navy Veteran of 5 years.

I was formerly a professional classical musician (flutist) before I went into software. I now look to do music for fun/on the side, and am a huge supporter of the fine arts. Open to these connections as well!

positions.title: Full-Stack Java Developer
positions.description:
Cognixia’s JUMP program is a hyper-intense technical training program that gives top STEM talent from across the U.S. the equivalent of 12-18 months of industry experience. Not only do they up-skill their technical abilities, they also evolve their digital mindset to successfully adapt and utilize technology in an efficient manner so they can JUMP start their careers via deployment with Collabera clients.

-Database Proficiency - in RDBMS MySQL as well as NoSQL with MongoDB
-Database Design – designed databases under principles of Normalization and ACID and SOLID patterns
-Developed a Full suite Spring Boot REST API, implementing Spring Security, Hibernate, JPA, and 
Mockito Test Suite
-Design Flexibility – experience with DAO and DTO design patterns, JDBC, JPA and Hibernate for interfacing with Data Persistence

positions.title: Navy Musician
positions.description:
-Navy Musicians (MUs) perform at elaborate productions and events such as presidential inaugurations, special ceremonies for foreign dignitaries, Navy celebrations and international parades
-Performed at over 100 events annually throughout Navy Region Southwest
-Taught educational clinics for numerous high school band students
